title: Thirty dollars a week with Kelly Martin; Vido Musso and Roy Eldridge
summary: His Club Congo pay was thirty to forty dollars, spent on room, food, reeds and music; he met Vido Musso and Roy Eldridge in Detroit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What was that paying for you? What was the range?
Oh, I think it was around thirty dollars a week.
Thirty dollars a week and you were
Were you paid by Kelly Martin directly or were you...
I think, when I look back, Kelly Martin paid us. Yeah. I think it was thirty or forty dollars, which was good money for me. My God, I thought it was a fortune. Hahahaha.
What did you spend the money on?

The room and food. That's all. Reeds. Music, you know. I met, one day, I met Vido Musso. Benny Goodman was in town and...he was a nice fellow...and we was talkin' about mouthpieces and sound and whatnot and then, another day, at this music store, I met Roy Eldridge in there. Hehheh.
